ussd.title: USSD simulator
ussd.subtitle: The same eight screens a farmer sees on any phone. The demo uses the callback contract from the SRS.
ussd.startPrompt: Dial the service code to start a session.
ussd.screenHint: Press a number and send. CON means the session continues. END means it has finished.
ussd.overLimit: This screen is over the 160-character limit.
ussd.demoHint: Simulator only. No SMS is sent and no real phone number is used.
ussd.invalidChoice: That reply is not one of the options. Try again.
ussd.sessionExpired: The session timed out. Dial again to start.
ussd.callbackError: The USSD callback failed. Check that the sample API is running.
ussd.keypadHint: Use the keypad or type a reply.
